description.en: Creates a "bustup" portrait image (the close-up character art shown during dialogue) for a given model, and orients it to the left or right side of the screen.
Handle of the character model to create the bustup image from.
Name to assign the bustup image.
Optional; true (default) places the bustup on the right side, false on the left.
Handle of the newly created bustup image.

example.code:
// Create a character's bustup portrait for a dialogue scene
local hTenmaImg = CreateBustup(hTenmaL, "\x0082\x00c4\x0082\x00f1\x0082\x00dc\x008a\x00e7");
